stories.title: Second annual Winter Festival & Christmas Market takes over Kendall Yards
stories.summary: The event runs from Nov. 30 to Dec. 19 and features holiday experiences, local shopping, live entertainment and family activities.

stories.title: Suspect in 1986 murder may have dementia, court records show
stories.summary: A judge ordered David Tibbett to undergo a competency evaluation after his attorney said he had trouble understanding his charge and whether he was in jail or not.

stories.title: U.S. Marshals Service increases reward for information on Ronald Alan Rutledge, now searching for second suspect
stories.summary: Authorities say Jesse Watkins was present at the crime scene, also currently under investigation, and may face charges related to the incident.

stories.title: Run Turkey Trots in Spokane and Idaho to burn calories before Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Thanksgiving traditions meet fitness goals with various Spokane and Idaho Turkey Trots on November 26 and 27, offering races for all ages and charity opportunities.

stories.title: Brabeion Academy founder Branden Durst separates from school. State also investigating alleged financial questions
stories.summary: The Idaho Public Charter School Commission is investigating financial irregularities at Brabeion Academy. The academy's founder has confirmed he's stepping away.

stories.title: Holiday on the Ave is back for its 8th year
stories.summary: Holiday on the Ave is happening on Saturday, Dec. 5, starting at 10 a.m.

stories.title: Jury deliberates Stratton murder case
stories.summary: Before sunup on the morning of Sept. 18, 2025, someone entered the Coeur d'Alene home of 77-year-old Susan Stratton, attacked her in bed, and caused fatal injuries.

stories.title: Hayden OKs contract with KCSO
stories.summary: The Hayden City Council unanimously approved a month-to-month contract to resume law enforcement services from the Kootenai County Sheriff’s Office on Tuesday night.

stories.title: KREM Exclusive: Sister of Stevens County armed fugitive pleads for him to surrender
stories.summary: "He's my brother. He's my only sibling, and do I care about him? Am I worried about him? Absolutely," says Sandra Rutledge, the sister of wanted man Ronald Rutledge.

stories.title: Orofino teen Life Flighted to hospital after crash in Clearwater County
stories.summary: An 18-year-old had to be transported to a hospital by Life Flight after being involved in a crash with a logging truck on Grangemont Road Tuesday morning.

stories.title: Judge makes no ruling as 'Spokane Three' aim to overturn federal convictions related to 2025 ICE protest
stories.summary: The three individuals convicted of federal conspiracy after the June 2025 ICE protest in downtown Spokane are hoping to overturn a jury's decision.

stories.title: Washington governor says Nippon Dynawave penalties must send a message to other businesses about worker safety
stories.summary: Gov. Bob Ferguson says accountability is necessary after 11 workers died and several others were injured in the May tank failure.
